records.tagline: Client Access Software For Marketing Agencies
records.description: Send your client one link. Get full access to 30+ platforms they use in seconds.

records.name: StoryChief Connect
records.tagline: Publish content from Claude to your website and socials
records.description: Plan, create, and distribute content across every channel from one workspace. StoryChief Connect gives Claude, and your marketing team access to the tools, data, workflows, and publishing channels they need to execute real campaigns. Connect your stack. Turn signals into strategy. Create content for every channel. Collaborate, schedule, publish, and improve from one connected content calendar.ryChief helps marketing teams ship more, with less.

records.name: calcolo codice fiscale
records.tagline: Calcolo e verifica del Codice Fiscale in pochi secondi
records.description: Calcolo codice fiscale semplice e veloce. Scopri come calcolare il codice fiscale online in pochi secondi, senza errori.

records.name: EdSteps AI
records.tagline: Your Personal AI Career Navigator
records.description: Making big career moves can feel lonely and overwhelming. EdSteps AI is here to change that. We’ve built a suite of specialized AI agents trained on real student experiences, career paths, and application journeys. Whether you're asking "What should I do with my life?", struggling with complex applications, or transitioning into a new city and job, EdSteps AI is the ultimate support system behind your next big decision.

records.name: Litter Layer
records.tagline: Indie search and social bookmarking federation.
records.description: Litter Layer started out as search only. Now there is a federated portion and social bookmarking with commenting. Users can even customize a public bookmarks page with CSS. Privacy and 100% control over your account is a priority. Setting up a node is easy and works even with cheap shared hosting, and comes with a search widget for your site. Bookmark search results, or add any bookmarks you want and they'll be added to the search engine. Create a fun avatar (cartoon or shapes).

records.name: EasyFaceSwap
records.tagline: Fast, realistic AI face swaps in your browser
records.description: Swap faces online for free with EasyFaceSwap. Upload two photos and get natural, photorealistic results in seconds, with no sign-up and no watermark.

records.name: Mapsprink
records.tagline: Track your travels down to states, prefectures & districts
records.description: Most travel apps stop at "been to that country." Mapsprink goes deeper: check in a country, then its states/provinces, and in 27 countries all the way down to individual districts. Earn medals, collect stickers, locate yourself, works fully offline, and backs up to your own Google Drive — no account, your data stays yours.
